description: This file defines an abstract class 'RtNotifier' with several pure virtual methods related to Xcast application management and RT service disconnection notifications.

classes.name: RtNotifier
classes.description: An abstract class designed as an interface for notification callbacks related to RT service and Xcast application requests.

methods.name: onRtServiceDisconnected
methods.description: Callback invoked when the RT service disconnects.

methods.name: onXcastApplicationLaunchRequest
methods.description: Callback for handling application launch requests, with application name and parameters.

methods.name: onXcastApplicationStopRequest
methods.description: Callback for handling application stop requests, identified by appName and appID.

methods.name: onXcastApplicationHideRequest
methods.description: Callback for handling requests to hide the application, identified by appName and appID.

methods.name: onXcastApplicationResumeRequest
methods.description: Callback for handling resume requests for the application.

methods.name: onXcastApplicationStateRequest
methods.description: Callback for handling state requests for the application.
